more_info.overview: Peptones are mixtures of amino acids and short protein chains obtained by partial breakdown of proteins. The starting proteins may come from animal tissues, milk, eggs or soy. FDA describes production using suitable enzymes, acids or heat. The ingredient has nutrient, processing-aid and surface-active functions, and its composition depends on the starting protein and treatment.
more_info.origin: Produced by partial hydrolysis of proteins using suitable proteolytic enzymes, acids or heat. FDA's permitted starting materials include milk proteins, egg albumin, animal tissue, gelatine and soy protein isolate. Peptones can therefore be plant- or animal-derived, depending on the actual starting protein.
